title: Northstar Analytics - weekly sync
next_steps: Redwood to update SUP-4840 with readiness/warmup mitigation details
Northstar to run another scale event after patch deploy and report timeout rate
Redwood to share recommended ingress/NLB timeout defaults for dedicated
transcript:
Meeting header
- Date: 2026-03-12
- Duration: 34 min
- Attendees: Laura Bennett (Redwood), Hiro Tanaka (Redwood), Samir (Northstar), Jules (Northstar)

[00:00] Laura Bennett: Hey folks. Quick agenda, I know you pinged about timeouts after scaling.
[00:18] Samir: Yeah. We scaled from eight to twelve GPUs and right after that we saw like ten percent 504s from our load balancer. It’s weird because CPU looks fine.
[00:35] Jules: Requests just hang and then time out. If we retry it usually works.
[00:50] Hiro Tanaka: When the new pods come up, are they getting traffic immediately?
[01:02] Samir: Yeah, once they’re Ready they’re in the target group.
[01:15] Hiro Tanaka: I suspect our readiness is too shallow. It might say Ready before the model is actually loaded. So you hit a cold pod and it takes too long and your NLB times out.
[01:34] Laura Bennett: I’m going to open a Sev1 support escalation so we can track comms and mitigation.
[01:46] Samir: Please do. This is blocking our rollout.
[02:10] Hiro Tanaka: I can add a warmup gate—basically keep the pod out of service until model load completes. Also we can pre-pull weights to cut the time.
[02:40] Jules: What about tuning our LB timeout? It’s at 60 seconds.
[02:55] Hiro Tanaka: You can bump it as a workaround, but we should fix readiness regardless.
[03:20] Laura Bennett: Ticket will be SUP-4840. I’ll add offering + symptom tags per our escalation policy.
[04:05] Samir: Great. Also can you send the recommended timeouts doc?
[04:18] Laura Bennett: Yep, we’ll follow up after the call.

[33:10] Laura Bennett: Recap: Hiro ships the warmup gate today, we’ll do a controlled scale event tonight, and you’ll tell us if the timeout rate drops to zero.
[33:28] Samir: Sounds good.
